_: Where the weapon hat sits on each gun (tools/roblox/hat_spots.py measures its height and writes roblox/src/shared/GunHatData.luau). z = along the gun (metres, the weapon frame, -z toward the muzzle), x = sideways, s = the hat's size (1 = as built, about 7 cm across), yaw = degrees, pitch = degrees about x after the yaw (90 stands the hat on the back end), sink = how far its foot goes into the surface (default 0.002), y = a fixed height instead of the measured one, saddle = metres the hat stands higher on a slate puck (a round scope or barrel).
